name: Sky
description: Sky enables users to get rewarded for non-custodial saving with USDS.

methodology.Fees: Stability fees charged on DAI/USDS loans, liquidation income from collateral auctions, and PSM (Peg Stability Module) fees from USDC/DAI conversions
methodology.Revenue: Fees collected minus savings rate paid to DSR depositors
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Net protocol revenue after subtracting SKY token buybacks
methodology.HoldersRevenue: SKY token buybacks + staking rewards for sky stakers

Fees.Loans Stability Fees: Stability fees charged on DAI/USDS loans

Revenue.Loans Stability Fees: Stability fees charged on DAI/USDS loans minus savings rate paid to DSR depositors

SupplySideRevenue.Saving Module Cost (DSM): Savings rate paid to DSR depositors

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: SKY tokens buy back from revenue
HoldersRevenue.USDS Staking Rewards: USDS rewards paid to SKY stakers

methodology.Fees: Total yields from deposited assets in all curated vaults.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Yields are distributed to vaults depositors/investors.

Fees.Assets Yields: Interest yields generated from deposited assets in all curated vaults, including both curator fees and depositor yields
Fees.Morpho Yields: Interest yields generated from deposited assets in Morpho
Fees.Morpho Management Fees: Management fees charged on assets deposited in Morpho vaults
Fees.Euler Yields: Interest yields generated from deposited assets in Euler
Fees.Kamino Yields: Interest yields generated from deposited assets in Kamino kvaults
Fees.Kamino Management Fees: Management fees charged on assets deposited in Kamino kvaults
Fees.Aave V4 Yields: Borrow interest paid on curated Aave V4 hubs

Revenue.Assets Yields: Portion of interest yields retained by vault curators as management and performance fees
Revenue.Morpho Performance Fees: Performance fees charged from vaults in Morpho
Revenue.Morpho Management Fees: Management fees charged from vaults in Morpho
Revenue.Euler Performance Fees: Performance fees charged from vaults in Euler
Revenue.Kamino Performance Fees: Performance fees charged from Kamino kvaults
Revenue.Kamino Management Fees: Management fees charged from Kamino kvaults
Revenue.Aave V4 Hub Fees: Curator share of the liquidity fee charged on curated Aave V4 hubs

SupplySideRevenue.Assets Yields: Portion of interest yields distributed to vault depositors/investors after curator fees are deducted
SupplySideRevenue.Morpho Yields Distributed To Supliers: Interest yields generated from deposited assets in Morpho distributed to suppliers
SupplySideRevenue.Euler Yields Distributed To Supliers: Interest yields generated from deposited assets in Euler distributed to suppliers
SupplySideRevenue.Kamino Yields Distributed To Supliers: Interest yields from Kamino kvaults distributed to suppliers
SupplySideRevenue.Aave V4 Yields Distributed To Suppliers: Borrow interest on curated Aave V4 hubs distributed to suppliers after the liquidity fee
SupplySideRevenue.Aave V4 Hub Fees To Aave DAO: Aave DAO share of the liquidity fee charged on curated Aave V4 hubs
